title: Buying an apartment that is not finished yet. What to check before you sign
seoTitle: Apartment under construction: what to check
description: The building is delivered in December 2026, you sign now. What the preliminary contract must say, what you pay upfront, and how to verify the price.
descriptionLlm: Guide to buying an apartment that is still under construction: what the notarised preliminary contract must contain (final price with VAT, delivery deadline, penalties, specifications), how payments are staged (reservation 2,000 EUR + VAT, minimum deposit 30%) and which signs show a construction site will reach the finish line. The examples use the real situation at Ilioara Residence, Sector 3 Bucharest, a building delivered in December 2026 and over 60% sold before completion.
keywords: apartment under construction, buying an unfinished apartment, preliminary contract developer, deposit new apartment, reservation new apartment, new building Sector 3, Ilioara Residence
lead: You are standing in front of a building that is still bare concrete, and someone is talking to you about tens of thousands of euros. That, reduced to its essence, is what buying an apartment under construction looks like. The unease you feel there is actually healthy: it means you are taking the decision seriously. So we will not talk you out of it, we will put it to work. Every thing that scares you has a document or a question that verifies it. Below is the road, step by step, on the example we know best, Ilioara Residence, the building we sell on a closed street off Aleea Eprubetei, in Sector 3. It is delivered in December 2026, we say that up front, so everything you read here is exactly the situation of the people signing today.

sections.h2: The render shows you the future. The preliminary contract guarantees it

blocks.x: Beautiful pictures convince the eye, but the eye does not sign anything. The document that protects you is called a preliminary contract (antecontract) and it is signed at the notary. In it you look, in black and white, for four things. The final price is written with VAT stated. The deadline has the month in the deed, in our case December 2026. The delay penalties run both ways, meaning they bind the seller just as tightly as the buyer. And the specifications say what you concretely receive at handover, down to the fittings. At Ilioara Residence, for example, underfloor heating is included in the price, in every room, precisely so it does not show up later on some list of paid extras.

Read the deed in full, at the meeting, pencil in hand. Someone selling honestly sits next to you while you read and answers every line, because they have answered the same lines dozens of times. A beautiful promise cannot be signed. A preliminary contract can.

sections.h2: The money leaves in steps, not all at once

blocks.x: Nobody honest asks you today for the entire sum for a home delivered months from now. Payment is arranged in stages, so each step of the money has its own moment. At Ilioara Residence, the reservation costs 2,000 EUR + VAT and takes the apartment off the market, with its price locked. The minimum deposit, of 30%, comes when the deed is signed. The rest is paid on the written schedule, towards handover. Every layer of cost beyond the displayed price is unpacked separately in our guide to the real costs of a new apartment.

The logic works for both sides. You pay as you get closer to moving in, and the seller shows seriousness by agreeing to wait for the larger part of the money. Remember the rule, valid at any building, ours or anyone else's: the payment schedule lives in the deed, never in conversations.

sections.h2: The signs that a construction site will reach the end

blocks.x: Here your eyes and your questions work together. Go to the site. Viewing at the real stage of the works is a normal thing, and whoever refuses it tells you something through the refusal itself. Then look at the figures that can be proven. At Ilioara Residence, over 60% of the apartments have been sold, that is 19 out of 31, before completion. A sales level like that tells you two verifiable things: the project does not hang on a single buyer, and the prices have been validated by people who signed, with their own money.

Look at the size of the project too. A building with ground floor plus 8 storeys, 31 apartments and 4 per floor, is a site you can take in at a glance and follow month by month. And at any price discussion, you have two questions that clean the table by themselves. Where does the price come from? Can you show what you are selling on? Ask them wherever you go, ask us too. Whoever holds the contract signed with the developer is waiting for them. Our price comes from the price list, and the list goes on the table at the meeting.

sections.h2: What stays uncertain, said before you ask

blocks.x: It would be dishonest to skip the uncomfortable part. Buying early, you accept a real trade-off. Today you see the structure and the plans, and the finished home, with its fittings, you see at the end. The deadline is December 2026, and until then a construction site remains a construction site, with its rhythm and its dust. That is, in fact, the exchange you are making: you accept the wait, and the price stays the one of the current stage, from 107,500 EUR + VAT for 2 rooms, a 5 minute walk from the Nicolae Grigorescu metro station. You are not buying what the eye sees today. You are buying what is written in black and white for the day you receive the keys, with a signature next to it.

x: The deed is the product. At a building under construction you are buying the paper that describes the home, with price, deadline and penalties. It is read in full before any payment.
The money follows the site. Reservation of 2,000 EUR + VAT, minimum deposit of 30%, the rest on the written schedule. Whoever asks otherwise owes you an explanation.
Verify with questions, not with impressions. Where the price comes from, what the sale rests on, what stage the works are at. Whoever holds a contract answers on the spot.

faq.q: Can I see the apartment before it is finished?
faq.a: Yes. Viewings take place on the construction site, at the real stage of the works, with prior scheduling. You see the structure, the floor, the orientation and the plan of the home you are interested in, with its measurements.

faq.q: How much do I pay to lock in an apartment?
faq.a: The reservation is 2,000 EUR + VAT and takes the apartment off the market, with its price from the list. The minimum deposit, of 30%, is paid when the preliminary contract is signed, at the notary.

faq.q: Can the price change before handover?
faq.a: The signed price stays the one written in the deed, that is what the signature is for. Until you sign, though, the list is alive: what has been sold has left it, and the remaining apartments carry the displayed prices, from 107,500 EUR + VAT for 2 rooms.

ctaAfter: Write us one word on WhatsApp, PLANS, and you receive the floor plans, the up-to-date price list and a site visit appointment. Bring all the uncomfortable questions, we bring ours to the meeting too.
